policy.projectSourceClaim: First-party browser source is 0BSD; first-party documentation and content are CC0-1.0. The official texts are kept separately.
policy.strictDistributionClaim: NOT SATISFIED. Not every redistributable component in this package is under CC0/0BSD. Aurora-D and Aurora-standard code are 0BSD but carry Unicode data under the Unicode License V3 and Microsoft Terminal MIT material; the D runtime/standard library linked into the executable is BSL-1.0; content decoding and PNG inflate reach zlib through std.zlib and etc.c.zlib, whose implementation is Zlib-licensed. Those are ordinary permissive licenses and are recorded here rather than relabeled.
notes: A wrapper module or a changed SPDX line does not resolve a conflict.
Third-party material in this repository has not been relicensed by this inventory.
All Aurora-owned package metadata now declares 0BSD, including the vendored Aurora-D and Aurora-standard copies; Unicode, Microsoft Terminal MIT, DMD/Phobos and zlib notices remain separate.

components.origin: original work written for this project
components.rightsEvidence: owner's request: 0BSD for first-party source and CC0-1.0 for first-party documentation/content; no per-file contributor provenance audit recorded yet
components.resolution: aurora-web/dub.json now declares 0BSD. Per-file provenance headers remain future work (brief 5.1: generated metadata is not a provenance audit).

components.origin: original work written for this project
components.rightsEvidence: owner's request: 0BSD for first-party source and CC0-1.0 for first-party documentation/content
components.resolution: aurora-browser/dub.json now declares 0BSD; per-file provenance remains future work.

components.component: Aurora-D GUI, text and raster toolkit (vendored)
components.origin: Aurora project source vendored into this repository; every patch is recorded in AURORA-PATCHES.md at the repository root and MANIFEST.sha256
components.rightsEvidence: vendor/aurora-d-0.4.5/LICENSE contains the 0BSD text; Unicode and Microsoft Terminal MIT notices are separate
components.resolution: Aurora-owned code is 0BSD. Keep the separate Unicode and Microsoft Terminal MIT notices with any distribution.

components.origin: generated from Unicode character data by the upstream library
components.resolution: Keep the Unicode notice with any distribution containing the tables; regenerating the tables does not remove the terms applicable to their inputs. Outside the strict CC0/0BSD target unless the owner accepts it.

components.component: D runtime and standard library (druntime, Phobos) linked into the executable
paths: not in this repository; linked from the compiler installation
components.rightsEvidence: the DMD distribution carries the Boost Software License 1.0 for druntime and Phobos
components.resolution: Classify the exact support libraries by inspecting a release binary's imports and static content; Boost is permissive but outside CC0/0BSD.

components.component: zlib compression reached through std.zlib and etc.c.zlib
components.origin: upstream zlib by Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler, reached through the D compiler distribution
components.rightsEvidence: the DMD distribution ships the zlib sources and notices; zlib license text
components.resolution: Replace the compression and inflate paths with original code, or record the owner's explicit acceptance; a D binding module does not make the implementation original.

paths: linked by name only: user32, gdi32, shell32, ws2_32, advapi32, ole32 (aurora-browser/dub.json, aurora-web/dub.json, build commands)
components.rightsEvidence: operating-system API; no associated runtime binary is copied into this repository
components.resolution: Classification only. Copying an associated runtime binary into a package would raise a separate distribution question.

components.component: Installed system fonts (Segoe UI and per-platform fallbacks)
paths: loaded at runtime by vendor/aurora-d-0.4.5/source/aurora/font.d from the OS font directory (for example C:\Windows\Fonts\segoeui.ttf)
components.rightsEvidence: font files remain on the host; they are read, never copied into this repository or a release package
components.resolution: Keep system fonts out of release artifacts; rendering them into screenshots is normal use, redistributing the files is not.

components.component: Installed Microsoft Edge browser used as the test oracle
components.versionOrCommit: the installed build (path recorded in each corpus manifest.json)
paths: aurora-opencode-pro/build/browser-reference-validation*/ manifest.json and the reference PNGs it pins
components.origin: installed system facility, used only to capture references for this project's own fixtures
components.rightsEvidence: third-party browser used as an external oracle; it is not part of the Aurora engine and is not redistributed
components.resolution: Never bundle Edge and never advertise it as the Aurora rendering engine (brief 5.3).

components.component: Frozen browser test corpus and captured baselines
components.origin: fixture HTML written for this project; reference PNGs generated by the installed Edge browser from those fixtures; live-site baselines (djangoproject.com, boqsc.eu) captured by this engine
components.rightsEvidence: project-owned fixtures; live-site captures are provenance-restricted third-party content
components.resolution: Keep generated references, live-site captures and user content out of release artifacts (brief 5.4); ship only the original fixture HTML if a test corpus is distributed.

components.component: Build-only toolchain (DMD 2.113.0, lld-link, Python for the capture and comparison scripts)
components.versionOrCommit: DMD 2.113.0; the rest as installed on the build host
components.rightsEvidence: UNRESOLVED: the compiler's linker and support libraries have not been identified by inspection of a release binary
components.resolution: Inspect the released executable's static content and imports and classify every embedded support library before publishing a binary package.

components.component: Build outputs committed in the working tree
components.origin: generated by this project's own builds
components.rightsEvidence: generated from the sources listed above; no separate grant needed while they are not published
components.licenseExpression: inherits its inputs (0BSD/CC0-1.0 plus Unicode/DMD/zlib terms)
components.resolution: Regenerate from source and keep committed build outputs out of release artifacts, so the package's license inventory matches its actual contents.

components.origin: original work written for this project
components.rightsEvidence: owner's request for the browser task
components.resolution: None outstanding; add SPDX headers alongside the rest of the first-party migration.

notApplicableFindings.finding: No embedded certificate bundle, trust anchor or provenance test certificate exists in aurora-web/source (a search for PEM markers, a trust store or root-certificate tables finds nothing).
notApplicableFindings.resolution: Not applicable today. If trust-chain validation is added, its certificate data becomes an inventory entry with its own provenance and terms.

notApplicableFindings.component: Web Platform Tests and Test262 suites
notApplicableFindings.finding: No external test suite is vendored: the corpus is original fixture HTML with references captured from the installed browser.
notApplicableFindings.resolution: If such a suite is ever added, keep its BSD-3-Clause notices intact in a separately pinned checkout outside the redistributable product (brief 5.4).
